description: A PHPUnit test class named UniqueRouteKeyTest that checks for uniqueness of route keys across plugins in a Symfony-based PHP project. It loads route configurations from YAML files and verifies that each route key is unique, throwing an exception if duplicates are found.

classes.name: UniqueRouteKeyTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class that verifies route key uniqueness in plugin configurations.

methods.name: testUniqueRouteKey
methods.description: Executes the test to ensure route keys are unique across loaded plugin route configuration files.
